verdict.rationale: Graphite lets users apply AI-suggested fixes in one click and use its built-in Agent to commit changes directly to the PR branch. Its only documented link to an external coding agent is Cursor Cloud Agents: a thread started in Cursor can continue in Graphite, which runs the opposite way from review findings flowing out to the user's agent. Missing for 10: copyable fix prompts from review comments, documented handoff of review findings into Cursor/Claude Code/Codex, Claude Code or Codex integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
